tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings during internship at Sunflower Trip.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Designed an admin dashboard for managing bookings, users, and travel packages, streamlining day-to-day operations for the internal team.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system for a restaurant client as a freelancer, using Angular with a C# and MS SQL Server backend, and deployed on Azure.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my interest in the Full Stack Engineer / Tech Intern position at IONIC. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to designing, developing, and implementing both front-end and back-end systems. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. I also implemented role-based access control and designed administrative dashboards to streamline operations. Additionally, my freelance experience includes delivering a Point of Sale system for an Australian restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, deployed live on Azure. My academic background in computer applications combined with hands-on MERN and full-stack project execution positions me well to take on the responsibilities of a tech intern and transition into a full-time opportunity over the 6-month duration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my technical background aligns with your engineering needs. Thank you for your time and consideration.

screening_answers.why_this_company: IONIC offers a paid tech internship ranging from INR 25K to 50K with a duration of 6 months and a clear path to a full-time opportunity, matching my career goals for a software engineering internship.
screening_answers.why_this_role: The role requires designing, developing, and implementing both front-end and back-end systems, which directly aligns with my full-stack experience building production web applications using Angular, Node.js, Express, MySQL, C#, and MS SQL Server during my internships.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring proven full-stack development experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip where I built and deployed a production-ready travel management system, as well as freelance experience delivering a live POS system on Azure using Angular and C#/MS SQL Server. I am currently pursuing an MCA at PES University with an 8.48 CGPA.
